articles.summary: WPP today announced the appointment of Adam Gerhart as Global Chief Client Officer. In this role, Adam will be responsible for leading WPP’s key global client relationships and overseeing the company’s network of Global Client Leaders. Based in New York, he joins WPP’s Executive Committee and reports to WPP’s Chief Operating Officer Devika Bulchandani.
articles.title: WPP appoints Adam Gerhart as Global Chief Client Officer

articles.summary: WPP appoints Tyler Turnbull, currently Global CEO of McCann, as CEO of WPP Creative, effective early 2027. Succeeding Jon Cook, Turnbull will unite WPP's creative agencies with its media, data, production and technology capabilities to drive client growth in the AI era.
articles.title: WPP appoints Tyler Turnbull as CEO of WPP Creative

articles.summary: We unite cutting-edge media intelligence, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company. Powered by exceptional talent and WPP Open, our pioneering agentic marketing platform, we operationalise AI at scale.
articles.title: Jon Cook to leave WPP and transition VML CEO role to long-time partner Eric Campbell
